title: Make the supervisor runtime and dev stack rebuildable on a fresh host

owned: A task-scoped, immutable review manifest for the fresh-host rebuild contract
Focused validation of supervisor config provisioning, immutable runtime promotion, watchdog installation and health evaluation
Focused validation of the non-production dev deployment script and shell entrypoints
not_changing: Secrets, credentials, systemd units, crontab or cloud resources
Supervisor, deployment or product runtime implementation
composes_with: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh and scripts/bootstrap.sh dev stack bring-up

supervisor: Create the stable coordination worktree outside the mutable product checkout
Run scripts/sync-dev-root.sh with explicit dev-root, live-config and coordination-root paths
Materialize and seal command-runtimes/<exact-sha>, provision the live config and promote that exact runtime
Install the persistent watchdog from the exact command runtime with --method auto --start-now
dev_stack: Supply the deployment environment and secret material outside Git
Use scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh for exact-version non-production delivery
Use scripts/bootstrap.sh for idempotent local/single-VM infrastructure, migration and application bring-up
Accept a deployment only after the deployment script's readiness and exact-SHA gates pass
rebuild_contract.authority_boundary: Command code is immutable, canonical task state lives in the coordination root, mutable source staging lives in dev-root, and product deployment truth remains separate from supervisor health.

commands: bash -n scripts/bootstrap.sh scripts/sync-dev-root.sh scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh scripts/run-supervisor-watchdog.sh scripts/run-supervisor.sh
results: All five shell entrypoints passed bash syntax validation
No whitespace errors before manifest creation
verification.environment_note: The worker image did not include pytest or PyYAML. A disposable /tmp virtual environment was created and those test-only packages were installed; no repository dependency or host runtime was changed.

acceptance_statement: At source head f73704e5a7b7bc78c959d7396f4e10b7e0623c26, the repository contains a coherent and focused-test-covered path to reconstruct the split-root supervisor runtime and dev stack on a newly provisioned host.
residual_risks: This task did not provision or destroy a real host, install OS packages, alter systemd/crontab, or deploy the dev stack; it proves the checked-in rebuild contract, not a fresh-host hosted exercise.
A real rebuild still requires operator-provided cloud access, external secret material, Docker, Git, bubblewrap with user namespaces, and either user systemd with linger or cron.
The two skipped tests are environment-dependent cases reported by the focused suite; independent review should inspect their skip reasons before treating a particular target host as ready.

checks: Confirm the task changes only this declared evidence artifact
Confirm the rebuild sequence matches the split-root and watchdog persistence runbook
Confirm the verification result is reproducible
Confirm the residual risks do not overstate source-contract evidence as hosted proof
